info.title: Kiruna Bus application API
info.description: Same-origin website API, independent of Boreal's upstream contract. Cached basic information is not live data. Live GPS fixes expire after three minutes. Public data does not require authentication; requests and upstream work are bounded.

get.summary: Read opt-in local upstream request/response capture
get.description: Available only with LOCAL_DEBUG=true on a loopback-bound, non-production server without trusted proxy support. Rejects non-local Host, socket, and cross-origin requests. Disabled servers return 404. Reads never activate collection or contact providers. Keeps at most 100 completed outbound attempts and 2 MiB in memory; each body is limited to 64 KiB with explicit truncation flags. Includes HTTP/network failures and individual retries, not cache hits. Recognized sensitive headers, query parameters, and JSON fields are redacted. No history is persisted.

get.summary: Public traffic information, independent of live buses
get.description: On-demand shared cache and single-flight fetch at most once per minute, with failure backoff. state=fresh may be empty; retained contains last-good notices after a refresh failure; unavailable is not an all-clear. ageSec includes source age and backend elapsed time; clients must continue aging it and expire it after 600 seconds. updated is a provider display string, not a timestamp. Unknown source entries invalidate the refresh. Retry-After may accompany a 200 response when a refresh has failed. No association to AnyRide identifiers or line filters is implied.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next permitted refresh, when applicable

get.summary: Basic map catalog without waiting for upstream
get.description: Returns a validated bundled or refreshed catalog. Source retained means part of the last refresh could not be verified and last-good entries were kept. ETag revalidation is supported. X-Server-Time is the current response time, including on 304, and is separate from catalog.capturedAt.

get.summary: Read the cached live snapshot and register collector activity
get.description: Never waits for or starts a request-specific upstream fetch. Live HTTP reads keep the shared collector active for 120 seconds; SSE connections also keep it active. A successful response can be partial or stale: inspect quality and original GPS timestamps. service.completeUntil is the network-wide coverage expiry, or null. When it is null, optional classifiedUntil and uncertainLineIds together allow absence inference only on other lines until that deadline. Coverage deadlines derive from the oldest response in the last full stop scan; partial scans cannot establish or extend them. service.windows contain lineId, routeId, from, until and expiresAt timestamps. Each window starts 30 minutes before the earliest observed departure (or arrival if departure is missing) and ends at the last observed call, expiring six minutes after its oldest supporting response. Missing service on older servers means unknown, not empty. Boreal supplies limited upcoming calls rather than a timetable. A stop with no forecast keeps forecastTime null and uses plannedTime. observedLines contains names discovered in calls. generatedAt is response assembly time, not data freshness. epoch identifies the process, revision orders dynamic publications within that epoch, and catalogVersion identifies static content.

get.summary: Subscribe to complete live snapshots over server-sent events
get.description: Keeps the shared collector active until disconnected. Immediately sends a full cached buses event or tracking-status when tracking is warming/unavailable. A dynamic cycle can publish updated departures and service evidence before GPS completes, in a separate revision. IDs are epoch:revision. Last-Event-ID is not replayed: every connection resynchronizes with the current full snapshot. Heartbeat comments arrive every 15 seconds and do not establish data freshness or reset the browser's 60-second snapshot watchdog. Status-only events do not reset it either. Connections and slow-reader buffers are bounded; shutdown closes streams.

200.description: Incremental UTF-8 SSE frames. Named events have JSON data matching the event schemas below. Headers disable caching/transformation and request proxy buffering to be disabled.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Passive reads do not start collection or extend its active window.

get.description: Reads the collector's per-stop calls cache without contacting the source. Default active reads register live-client activity. Includes cancellation and disruption messages. Failed refreshes retain last-good data as state=stale for up to two minutes from original updatedAt. Optional freshForMs and expiresInMs are the remaining freshness and retention at response assembly, measured with the server wall clock, not the provider clock. Optional previousDeparture contains one last observed passed call with its original observation time and disruption context; optional pendingDepartures contains bounded future observations for deadline tracking, not live upcoming calls. Neither confirms service. Observations are bounded, in memory, and may be absent, including after restart. If live calls have expired but observations exist, state=unavailable and calls is empty; updatedAt then identifies an observation, not live freshness. Otherwise missing or expired data returns 503 with Retry-After.

get.summary: Display-ready route geometry with provider corrections applied
get.description: Serves catalog and cached geometry. A cache miss triggers an upstream lookup only for route IDs recently observed in calls, service evidence, or unexpired vehicles.

Error.description: Structured error. 400 invalid request, 404 unknown resource, 405 wrong method, 413 body too large, 415 unsupported media, 429 rate limit, 502 invalid/unavailable upstream, 503 warming/overload, 504 upstream timeout. Retry-After is seconds where supplied. Methods and unknown/repeated query parameters are validated.
